text.en: 1. These Rules are the Co-operative Societies (Prescribed Rate of Contribution under Section 71(2)(a)) Rules 2025.

heading.en: Prescribed rate of contribution under section 71(2)(a) of Act

text.en: 2. The rate of 0% is prescribed in substitution of 5% for the contribution payable under section 71(2)(a) of the Act by a society for any financial year ending between 31 December 2024 and 30 September 2025 (both dates inclusive).
